Agent Name: Planner

Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the child of Michelle Phillips (the performer of "Victim of Romance"), incorrectly stating Mackenzie Phillips instead of Chynna Phillips. This reflects confusion between John Phillips’ daughter Mackenzie (not Michelle’s child) and Michelle’s actual daughter Chynna, and a failure to verify the familial relationship before concluding.
